Dated: 3rd July, 2023.

The Applicant apprehends his arrest in C.R. No. 291 of 2023 registered with Mangalvedha Police Station, Solapur (rural), for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 r/w 34 of the IPC and Sections 26(2)(i), (ii) and (iv),
27(3)(e) and 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act-2006.
2. Heard Mr. Kakade, learned counsel for the Applicant and Mr. R.M. Pethe, learned APP for the Respondent -State.
I have perused the records and considered the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the respective parties.
The aforesaid crime was registered pursuant to the FIR lodged by Food Safety Officer, Food and Drugs Administration, Solapur.

The facts narrated in the FIR reveal that on 17/04/2023 the First Informant had received information that some prohibited goods were likely to be transported from Somning Alias Somnath Shivanna Pujari vs State Of Maharashtra on 3 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44529116/
1 Nipani to Maharashtra.

sentences.text: Pursuant to the said information Vehicle No. MH-12-HD 7876 was intercepted.
It is alleged that some plastic bags carrying Hira Pan Masala and scented tobacco (prohibited goods) were being transported by the said vehicle.
Hence, crime came to be registered and the driver of the said vehicle was arrested.
The driver informed that the said vehicle is owned by the Applicant herein.
On the basis of the said information the Applicant came to be arrayed as an accused in the said crime.
4. The only incriminating material against the Applicant is that he is the owner of the vehicle, which was used for transporting the prohibited goods.
There is no prima facie material to indicate that the Applicant was involved in purchase or sale of the said prohibited goods.
Furthermore, prima facie the applicability of Section 328 of the IPC is also doubtful.
Other offences are bailable.
Considering the above facts and circumstances, this is a fit case to exercise discretion under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. in favour of the Applicant.
(iv) The Applicant shall keep the Investigating Officer informed of his current address and mobile contact numbers, and /or change of residence or mobile details, if any, from time to time.
6. The application stands disposed of.

(SMT. ANUJA PRABHUDESSAI, J.)
